examples.explanation: The longest continuous increasing subsequence is [1,3,5] with length 3. Even though [1,3,5,7] is an increasing subsequence, it is not continuous as elements 5 and 7 are separated by element 4.
The longest continuous increasing subsequence is [2] with length 1. Note that it must be strictly increasing.
